purpose: Evaluate the proposed existing-capability one-copy GU placement and whole-row sparse CR/IPR stream; reject unsupported performance attribution.
authorization: User resumed experiments and authorized up to three gpt-6.1-sol xhigh subagents.
freeze_stage: Experimental design before root full-FFN replay and before any new evaluation-data selection. Child geometry, numeric and TRAIN-only baseline work can proceed independently.

user_assumed: synchronized independent page addresses across four planes
unverified_modes_to_separate: sparse GEMV address sequencing and continuation
bias retention across idle or paced reads
prohibited_silent_assumptions: different experts' Down operands treated as common input

candidate.claim_scope: Page-count and native row-stream construction, conditional on supported source selection; not measured hardware latency.

comparators: separate expert GU runs with the same CR and ECC parameters
packed same-WL skip-CR, TRAIN-only maximum-weight matching ordering
IPR conventional global round-robin packing with the same selected bytes
IPR phase-aligned routed pages and balanced shared pages
generic sparse common-operand compiler allowed the same candidate layout and schedule

data.initial_replay: TRAIN L0 through L2, then all layers only if meaningful unresolved concerns or improvement justify expansion.
data.evaluation_policy: Freeze layouts and source/config hashes before evaluation routes. Previously inspected heldout archives are reused evaluation, not fresh prospective evidence. Do not fit to evaluation routes.

full_ffn_contract.dependencies: Full GU outputs at host before whole-vector activation/A8 and private Down upload; weighted combine waits all routed and shared Down outputs.
resources: eight channels shared by two chips each
output backlog measured against explicit capacity
matched_down: available frozen strong whole-row Down maps for the same layer
full_ffn_contract.numerics: Fixed existing W8/A8 full-row reference, same bytes/scales and row accumulation order; no partial-column reduction.

required_evidence: independent exact integer and scaled-output checks
decision_rules: A wave-count gain is not an achievable latency result.
A generic compiler reproducing the same layout is a tie, not a novel optimizer win.
An infeasible strict timing mode is reported as infeasible; a conditional hold or new source selector cannot silently repair it.
Do not claim publication readiness without distinct contribution, executable resource contract, and complete-FFN benefit.
Preserve negative results and adapt subsequent methods in separately frozen follow-up artifacts.
